records.source: Send the unseen pages away before a polish that precedes the show.
records.translation: 在显示之前的样式处理发生前，先移走尚未看到的页面。

records.context: The warm-up polishes before it shows. Qt posts every new widget a ``PolishRequest``, and a dialog built ahead in an idle slice (:func:`_warm_the_preferences`) answers it in the next pass of the event loop, long before :meth:`setVisible`. The window sheet and the glass then walked all ~967 widgets of every tab in that one event: 425-484 ms offscreen, 0.36 s on the lesson capture host. The pages leave here as they would at the show, and the polish styles the open tab only.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.event#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: THE WARM-UP POLISHES BEFORE IT SHOWS. Qt posts every new widget a ``PolishRequest``, and a dialog built ahead in an idle slice (:func:`_warm_the_preferences`) answers it in the next pass of the event loop, long before :meth:`setVisible`. The window sheet and the glass then walked all ~967 widgets of every tab in that one event: 425-484 ms offscreen, 0.36 s on the lesson capture host. The pages leave here as they would at the show, and the polish styles the open tab only.
records.translation: 预热会在显示之前进行样式处理。Qt 会给每个新控件发送一个 ``PolishRequest``，而在空闲时段预先构建的对话框（:func:`_warm_the_preferences`）会在事件循环的下一轮响应它，远早于 :meth:`setVisible`。窗口样式表和玻璃效果随后在这一个事件中遍历了所有选项卡的全部约 ~967 个控件：离屏时为 425-484 ms，在课程录制主机上为 0.36 s。这里会像显示时那样移走各页面，样式处理只作用于当前打开的选项卡。

records.context: Only for a dialog the warm-up built, which says so through ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish``. Anything else that builds the dialog and lets the event loop run before walking a page -- the help search index reads every tab's form rows that way -- still finds every page where the builder put it until the show.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.event#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ONLY FOR A DIALOG THE WARM-UP BUILT, which says so through ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish``. Anything else that builds the dialog and lets the event loop run before walking a page -- the help search index reads every tab's form rows that way -- still finds every page where the builder put it until the show.
records.translation: 仅适用于由预热构建的对话框，它通过 ``_pages_leave_at_the_polish`` 表明这一点。其他任何构建该对话框并在遍历页面前让事件循环运行的代码——帮助搜索索引就是这样读取每个选项卡的表单行的——在显示之前仍会在构建器放置的位置找到每个页面。

records.translation: 将动态背景偏好设置推送到每个现存的动态背景控件。

records.context: The user's explicit ask was a toggle that works *now*, so this walks the running widget tree the same way :func:`spacr.qt.button_roles.install_button_roles` does and updates the widgets in place instead of waiting for the application views to be rebuilt. Hiding one also stops its timer (the widget stops animating whenever it is not visible), so "off" really is zero frames.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The user's explicit ask was a toggle that works *now*, so this walks the running widget tree the same way :func:`spacr.qt.button_roles.install_button_roles` does and updates the widgets in place instead of waiting for the screens to be rebuilt. Hiding one also stops its timer (the widget stops animating whenever it is not visible), so "off" really is zero frames.
records.translation: 用户明确要求的是一个*立即*生效的开关，因此此函数以与 :func:`spacr.qt.button_roles.install_button_roles` 相同的方式遍历正在运行的控件树，就地更新各控件，而不是等待界面重建。隐藏控件时也会停止其计时器（控件不可见时就会停止动画），因此 "off"（关闭）确实意味着零帧。

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_ambient_enabled#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Answers ``False`` outright when ``SPACR_NO_BACKDROP`` is set, whatever is stored. `spacr.qt.crash_recovery` sets it after spaCR has died on launch twice running: the backdrop is the only thing spaCR asks a driver to do at startup, and the setting that would turn it off is behind the window that never appears. Process-local and never saved, so the next clean run brings it back with nothing for the user to undo.
records.translation: 直接返回 ``False``（当设置了 ``SPACR_NO_BACKDROP`` 时），无论存储的值是什么。`spacr.qt.crash_recovery` 会在 spaCR 连续两次启动即崩溃后设置它：背景是 spaCR 在启动时唯一要求驱动程序完成的工作，而用于关闭它的设置位于那个始终不出现的窗口之后。该设置仅在进程内有效且从不保存，因此下一次正常运行会恢复它，用户无需撤销任何操作。

records.source: Default ``True``. When this is ``False`` no ambient widget should be installed at all — and any already-installed one is hidden and stopped by :func:`apply_ambient_preferences`, so the toggle takes effect the moment Preferences is saved rather than at the next launch.
records.translation: 默认 ``True``。当其为 ``False`` 时，根本不应安装任何动态背景控件——已安装的控件会由 :func:`apply_ambient_preferences` 隐藏并停止，因此开关在保存 Preferences 的那一刻就会生效，而不是等到下次启动。

records.context: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". The three install sites all read this function before they build anything, so answering ``False`` for None here is what makes the guarantee true everywhere at once, without a second condition in three other modules that could drift apart.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_ambient_enabled#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". The three install sites all read this function before they build anything, so answering ``False`` for None here is what makes the guarantee true everywhere at once, without a second condition in three other modules that could drift apart.
records.translation: **两个键回答同一个问题，并且两者都会被遵守。** Animation 偏好设置新增了一个 ``None`` 选项（参见 :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`），而 "no animation"（无动画）必须意味着*不构建任何东西*，而不是 "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second"（一个每秒绘制六十次空白帧的引擎）。三处安装位置都会在构建任何东西之前读取此函数，因此在这里对 None 返回 ``False``，就能让这一保证在所有地方同时成立，而无需在其他三个模块中再加可能彼此偏离的第二个条件。

records.context: What this reaches and what it does not. It is the colour of the figure's CHROME: the axis spines and the tick marks. It is deliberately not pushed over the data's own lines on every render, because a preference that repainted every series in one ink would flatten every multi-series figure in the package the first time a theme was read. The control that DOES reach the data's lines is the per-figure one (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_settings.apply_line_colour`), which is a user asking for it about one figure -- the same division as the pyqtgraph side, where the theme sets `_foreground` and `set_line_colour` is a menu entry.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: WHAT THIS REACHES AND WHAT IT DOES NOT. It is the colour of the figure's CHROME: the axis spines and the tick marks. It is deliberately not pushed over the data's own lines on every render, because a preference that repainted every series in one ink would flatten every multi-series figure in the package the first time a theme was read. The control that DOES reach the data's lines is the per-figure one (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_settings.apply_line_colour`), which is a user asking for it about one figure -- the same division as the pyqtgraph side, where the theme sets `_foreground` and `set_line_colour` is a menu entry.
records.translation: 它作用于什么、不作用于什么。它是图形外框的颜色：坐标轴轴脊和刻度线。它有意不在每次渲染时覆盖数据本身的线条，因为一个把每个系列都重绘成同一墨色的偏好设置，会在第一次读取主题时就让软件包中的每张多系列图形变得单调。真正作用于数据线条的是逐图形的控件（:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_settings.apply_line_colour`），即用户针对某一张图提出的要求——与 pyqtgraph 一侧的划分相同，在那里主题设置 `_foreground`，而 `set_line_colour` 是一个菜单项。

records.context: Two consumers, and they treat it differently on purpose. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png` clamps it for the on-application view raster — a 16x12" figure at 300 DPI is a 4800 px PNG that costs more to decode than any application view can show — so a large figure is displayed at a lower DPI than the one chosen here. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf` uses the value unclamped, because the PDF is a file rather than a screenful and its embedded rasters really do need the resolution the user asked for.

records.source: Two consumers, and they treat it differently on purpose. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png` clamps it for the on-screen raster — a 16x12" figure at 300 DPI is a 4800 px PNG that costs more to decode than any screen can show — so a large figure is displayed at a lower DPI than the one chosen here. :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf` uses the value unclamped, because the PDF is a file rather than a screenful and its embedded rasters really do need the resolution the user asked for.
records.translation: 有两个使用方，它们有意以不同方式处理该值。:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png` 会为屏幕栅格图限制该值——300 DPI 下 16x12" 的图形是一张 4800 px 的 PNG，解码代价超过任何屏幕能显示的内容——因此大图形会以低于此处所选的 DPI 显示。:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue._export_vector_pdf` 则不加限制地使用该值，因为 PDF 是一个文件而不是一屏内容，其中嵌入的栅格图确实需要用户所要求的分辨率。

records.context: A suggestion is judged, not relabelled. An extracted image region Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the structured-data name legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.annotate#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A suggestion is judged, not relabelled. A crop Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the key legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.
records.translation: 建议是要被判定的，而不是被重新标记。Suggest 为其提议了类别的裁剪图，会在虚线环旁带有一个琥珀色的 ``?`` 徽标。单击或按 ``Y`` 确认（它变为普通标签并带有绿色对勾）；右键单击或按 ``N`` 拒绝（它回到未作答状态并带有红色叉号）；``U`` 撤销任一操作。按键说明上方的提示栏会说明这一点，并统计该页和该列的情况。每次判定都会写入 ``<column>_verdict`` 列，值为 ``+c`` 或 ``-c``，因此重启后依然保留，下一轮 Suggest 会拿到这些拒绝结果用于训练。参见 :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` 和 :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`。

records.context: An UPDATE against ``measurements.db`` is unrecoverable, so every guard below has to fail open to *read-only*:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: An UPDATE against ``measurements.db`` is unrecoverable, so every guard below has to fail open to *read-only*:
records.translation: 对 ``measurements.db`` 执行的 UPDATE 无法恢复，因此下面的每一道保护在失效时都必须回落到*只读*：

records.context: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable` must be on — it is off by default and lives in Preferences, not on this screen. 2. The database must have been chosen explicitly in this session (``set_database(..., explicit=True)``). 3. The user must tick "Edit mode" *and* confirm; ticking alone does nothing. 4. The row must be addressable by ``rowid`` or a primary structured-data name. Without one, the edit is refused — an UPDATE matching on column values can hit many rows, which on a measurements table is silent mass corruption. The write also probes ``COUNT(*)`` for the row address first and rolls back unless ``rowcount == 1``. 5. The typed text must be coercible to the column's declared type. SQLite stores ``'abc'`` in an INTEGER column without error; :func:`coerce_for_column` refuses instead.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable` must be on — it is off by default and lives in Preferences, not on this screen. 2. The database must have been chosen explicitly in this session (``set_database(..., explicit=True)``). 3. The user must tick "Edit mode" *and* confirm; ticking alone does nothing. 4. The row must be addressable by ``rowid`` or a primary key. Without one, the edit is refused — an UPDATE matching on column values can hit many rows, which on a measurements table is silent mass corruption. The write also probes ``COUNT(*)`` for the row address first and rolls back unless ``rowcount == 1``. 5. The typed text must be coercible to the column's declared type. SQLite stores ``'abc'`` in an INTEGER column without error; :func:`coerce_for_column` refuses instead.
records.translation: 1. :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_db_browser_editable` 必须开启——它默认关闭，位于 Preferences 中，而不在此页面上。2. 数据库必须是在本次会话中明确选择的（``set_database(..., explicit=True)``）。3. 用户必须勾选 "Edit mode" *并且*确认；仅勾选不起作用。4. 该行必须能通过 ``rowid`` 或主键定位。没有这样的键时，编辑会被拒绝——按列值匹配的 UPDATE 可能命中许多行，在测量表上这就是悄无声息的大规模数据损坏。写入时还会先针对行地址探测 ``COUNT(*)``，除非 ``rowcount == 1`` 否则回滚。5. 输入的文本必须能转换为该列声明的类型。SQLite 会把 ``'abc'`` 存入 INTEGER 列而不报错；:func:`coerce_for_column` 则会拒绝。

records.context: Design notes that matter for real spaCR databases:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Design notes that matter for real spaCR databases:
records.translation: 对真实 spaCR 数据库而言重要的设计说明：

records.context: **Background execution.** Each chunk, count, and export runs outside the GUI thread through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, also used by workflow screens. Each worker opens and closes **a separate** sqlite connection; ``sqlite3`` objects cannot be shared between execution threads. Jobs run **sequentially**. :meth:`DbBrowserScreen._run_job` explains why two ``PipelineWorker``\ s cannot overlap.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Every chunk, count and export goes through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, the same helper the pipeline screens use, and each worker opens (and closes) its **own** sqlite connection — ``sqlite3`` objects are not shareable across threads. Jobs queue and run **one at a time**; see :meth:`DbBrowserScreen._run_job` for why two ``PipelineWorker``\ s must not overlap.
records.translation: **在 GUI 线程之外运行。** 每次分块读取、计数和导出都通过 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 进行，这与流程界面使用的辅助函数相同，并且每个工作线程都会打开（并关闭）**自己的** sqlite 连接——``sqlite3`` 对象不能跨线程共享。作业排队并**逐个**运行；参见 :meth:`DbBrowserScreen._run_job`，其中说明了为什么两个 ``PipelineWorker``\ s 不能重叠。

records.context: **Cancellable.** Switching table or database bumps a load token. Results tagged with a stale token are dropped, so an in-flight load can never paint the previous table's rows into the new view, and a job that has not started yet is dropped without spending an independent execution path. Nothing is ever killed mid-flight.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Cancellable.** Switching table or database bumps a load token. Results tagged with a stale token are dropped, so an in-flight load can never paint the previous table's rows into the new view, and a job that has not started yet is dropped without spending a thread. Nothing is ever killed mid-flight.
records.translation: **可取消。** 切换表或数据库会递增一个加载令牌。带有过期令牌的结果会被丢弃，因此进行中的加载绝不会把前一个表的行绘制到新视图中，尚未开始的作业也会被直接丢弃而不占用线程。任何作业都不会在运行中途被强行终止。

records.context: **Read-only by default, structurally.** Browsing connections are opened with the ``file:…?mode=ro`` URI *and* ``PRAGMA query_only = ON``. A write is rejected by SQLite itself, not by an application-level check. Editing is a separate, opt-in path (see below) with its own connection.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Read-only by default, structurally.** Browsing connections are opened with the ``file:…?mode=ro`` URI *and* ``PRAGMA query_only = ON``. A write is rejected by SQLite itself, not by an application-level check. Editing is a separate, opt-in path (see below) with its own connection.
records.translation: **默认只读，且从结构上保证。** 浏览连接以 ``file:…?mode=ro`` URI *并且*以 ``PRAGMA query_only = ON`` 打开。写入会被 SQLite 本身拒绝，而不是由应用层检查拒绝。编辑是一条独立的、需选择启用的路径（见下文），使用自己的连接。

records.context: **Incremental fetch.** ``canFetchMore``/``fetchMore`` are Qt's incremental-loading interface; the view calls them when the user scrolls to the bottom and the model asks the application view for another chunk. While a chunk is in flight ``canFetchMore`` is False, so a scroll cannot schedule ten of them.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser.PreviewModel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Incremental fetch.** ``canFetchMore``/``fetchMore`` are Qt's incremental-loading interface; the view calls them when the user scrolls to the bottom and the model asks the screen for another chunk. While a chunk is in flight ``canFetchMore`` is False, so a scroll cannot queue ten of them.
records.translation: **增量获取。** ``canFetchMore``/``fetchMore`` 是 Qt 的增量加载接口；用户滚动到底部时视图会调用它们，模型再向界面请求下一块数据。某块数据正在获取时 ``canFetchMore`` 为 False，因此一次滚动无法排入十个请求。

records.context: **Row identity.** Every row carries the structured-data name tuple it was fetched with (``rowid``, or the primary structured-data name). That is what makes an edit addressable — and its absence is what makes an edit refusable.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Row identity.** Every row carries the key tuple it was fetched with (``rowid``, or the primary key). That is what makes an edit addressable — and its absence is what makes an edit refusable.

records.context: paging falls back to ``OFFSET``. records.context: **Brush** and **Erase** paint and unpaint the active label a pixel at a time. **Erase object** removes a whole label in one click. **Wand** grows a region from the pixel clicked and adds it to the mask by default. Hold Ctrl while clicking to remove that region; the tolerance is relative to the image's intensity range by default, see :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`. **Draw** traces a free-form outline that closes and fills as ONE object -- the tool a brush is not, because a brush stamps disks along the path, so tracing a rim with it labels the rim and leaves the middle background. **Divide / Merge** uses a left-button drag to divide and a right-button drag to merge crossed objects under the first touched identifier without changing their pixels. The merged identity is retained when saving and reopening. Dividing drags a line across a merged object and makes it two, keeping the original identifier on the larger component and giving the smaller a new one, with every other object untouched; :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH` is the cut width. **Zoom** rectangle-drags the view and changes no labels at all.

records.source: **Brush** and **Erase** paint and unpaint the active label a pixel at a time. **Erase object** removes a whole label in one click. **Wand** grows a region from the pixel clicked and adds it to the mask by default. Hold Ctrl while clicking to remove that region; the tolerance is relative to the image's intensity range by default, see :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`. **Draw** traces a free-form outline that closes and fills as ONE object -- the tool a brush is not, because a brush stamps disks along the path, so tracing a rim with it labels the rim and leaves the middle background. **Divide / Merge** uses a left-button drag to divide and a right-button drag to merge crossed objects under the first touched identifier without changing their pixels. The merged identity is retained when saving and reopening. Dividing drags a line across a merged object and makes it two, keeping the original identifier on the larger component and giving the smaller a new one, with every other object untouched; :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH` is the cut width. **Zoom** rectangle-drags the view and changes no labels at all.
records.translation: **Brush** 和 **Erase** 逐像素地涂上或擦除当前标签。**Erase object** 单击即可移除整个标签。**Wand** 从单击的像素开始生长出一个区域，默认将其添加到掩膜中。单击时按住 Ctrl 可移除该区域；容差默认相对于图像的强度范围，参见 :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance`。**Draw** 描绘一条自由轮廓，闭合后填充为一个对象——这正是画笔做不到的，因为画笔沿路径盖印圆盘，用它描边只会标记边缘而让中间仍是背景。**Divide / Merge** 用左键拖动进行分割，用右键拖动将经过的对象合并到第一个触及的标识符下，且不改变其像素。合并后的标识在保存和重新打开后保持不变。分割时在合并后的对象上拖出一条线，将其变为两个对象：较大的部分保留原标识符，较小的部分获得新标识符，其他对象均不受影响；:data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.DIVIDE_CUT_WIDTH` 为切割宽度。**Zoom** 通过矩形拖动缩放视图，完全不改变任何标签。

records.context: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on application view rather than what is painted on it. A staged extracted image region holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.

records.source: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on screen rather than what is painted on it. A staged crop holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.
records.translation: **Recrop** 是第九个工具，也是唯一一个改变界面上显示哪个视野、而不是改变其上所绘内容的工具。包含多个细胞的暂存裁剪图并不是一个训练样本，把它当作一个样本来整理会让网络学到两个对象是一幅图——因此，围绕某个对象画框会把图像和掩膜的该区域写成一个独立的视野（:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`），紧排在当前视野之后进入队列，而包含多个对象的原始视野会被移入 ``recropped_originals/``，不再整理（:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`）。边长小于 :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` 的框，或与已有裁剪重叠超过 :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP` 的框会被拒绝；被框切开的对象会被丢弃，因为边界落在鼠标松开处的对象已不是原来那个对象；保留下来的标签从一开始重新编号。

records.context: ``_MaskLoadWorker`` is parented to this widget, so without this the application view's destructor deletes a QThread that is still decoding a large TIFF, and Qt answers that with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")`` — a core dump, not an exception. records.source: ``_MaskLoadWorker`` is parented to this widget, so without this the screen's destructor deletes a QThread that is still decoding a large TIFF, and Qt answers that with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")`` — a core dump, not an exception. The window is exactly as wide as one image decode, which is why it shows up in a loaded test shard and almost never by hand.
records.translation: ``_MaskLoadWorker`` 的父对象是此控件，因此若没有这一步，界面的析构函数会删除一个仍在解码大型 TIFF 的 QThread，而 Qt 对此的响应是 ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``——这是核心转储，而不是异常。出问题的时间窗口恰好等于一次图像解码的时长，这就是为什么它会出现在负载较重的测试分片中，而手动操作时几乎从不出现。

records.context: Closing the panel is not enough. A module polls the machine's RAM and GPU on a background execution unit, and Qt answers an executing QThread being destroyed by aborting the process — so the module's own close handler, which drains that worker, has to execute. A page nested inside another module's tabs never gets one from Qt, which is why they are closed by hand here.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.close_folded#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Closing the panel is not enough. A module polls the machine's RAM and GPU on a worker thread, and Qt answers a running QThread being destroyed by aborting the process — so the module's own close handler, which drains that worker, has to run. A page nested inside another module's tabs never gets one from Qt, which is why they are closed by hand here.
records.translation: 仅关闭面板是不够的。模块会在工作线程上轮询机器的 RAM 和 GPU，而 Qt 在正在运行的 QThread 被销毁时会中止进程——因此必须运行模块自身负责排空该工作线程的关闭处理器。嵌套在另一个模块选项卡中的页面永远不会从 Qt 收到关闭事件，这就是这里要手动关闭它们的原因。

records.context: Every module that was built, not every module that was opened. A module is built the moment something asks this application view to point it at the open folder — :meth:`seed_folded` does, and so does any test or caller reaching for :meth:`folded_screen` — and pointing Model Compare at a folder starts a load independent execution path before its panel has ever been on application view. Walking the panels alone left those independent execution paths executing with nothing holding them, and the process died of it several actions later, in whatever happened to be executing when the memory behind them was touched.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.close_folded#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: EVERY MODULE THAT WAS BUILT, not every module that was opened. A module is built the moment something asks this screen to point it at the open folder — :meth:`seed_folded` does, and so does any test or caller reaching for :meth:`folded_screen` — and pointing Model Compare at a folder starts a load thread before its panel has ever been on screen. Walking the panels alone left those threads running with nothing holding them, and the process died of it several actions later, in whatever happened to be running when the memory behind them was touched.
records.translation: 是每个已构建的模块，而不是每个已打开的模块。只要有东西要求此界面把某个模块指向当前打开的文件夹，该模块就会被构建——:meth:`seed_folded` 会这样做，任何调用 :meth:`folded_screen` 的测试或调用方也会——而把 Model Compare 指向某个文件夹时，在其面板显示之前就会启动加载线程。只遍历面板会让这些线程在无人持有的情况下继续运行，进程会在数个操作之后因此崩溃，崩溃发生在其背后的内存被访问时恰好在运行的任何地方。

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Sibling screens (align / batch / convert / report / plate_view / …) solve this by never opening a modal at all — see their ``_set_status`` docstrings, which cite this screen as the case that actually hung. That is not sufficient here because "Clear mask" genuinely needs a yes/no answer, so this screen keeps the modal when — and only when — there is somebody able to answer it.
records.translation: 同级界面（align / batch / convert / report / plate_view / …）的解决办法是根本不打开模态对话框——参见它们的 ``_set_status`` 文档字符串，其中引用此界面作为真正卡死过的案例。但这在这里不够，因为 "Clear mask" 确实需要是/否回答，所以此界面会保留模态对话框，但仅限于确实有人能够回答的时候。

records.translation: Measure 通过 :func:`spacr.illumination.prepare_illumination_correction` 应用光照校正。集成的 Illumination 页面可以在完整测量运行之前单独估计和评估校正场。AnnData Export 提供带类型的设置表单，用于将测量表写为 ``.h5ad`` 文件。Motility Assay 对已有时间序列掩膜中的对象进行定量，并写出逐对象和逐轨迹的测量结果。

It has its own object name, ``AppTile``, so the stylesheet can give it a height floor without giving one to every horizontal tile in the app.
records.translation: 有意**不是** :class:`HTile` 的子类。``HTile`` 是水平行，其名称和说明位于按钮自身图标旁边的 ``QLabel`` 栈中；而这里是垂直堆叠，图标作为子标签绘制。它有自己的对象名 ``AppTile``，使样式表可以为它设置最小高度，而不必为应用中的每个水平磁贴都设置。

records.context: **Its height floor is in the QSS, not here.** ``setFixedSize`` does not survive polish, and neither does answering through ``sizeHint`` / ``minimumSizeHint``: the app stylesheet's blanket ``QPushButton { min-height: 22px }`` becomes a real ``setMinimumHeight(22)``, and ``qSmartMinSize`` lets an explicit minimum override the hints. On a page that does not fit, every tile then collapses to 22 px and paints its name over its icon. See :data:`spacr.qt.theme.TILE_H`. The hints below are still worth having — they are what the layout *prefers* — and ``heightForWidth`` is overridden with them because ``QWidgetItem::sizeHint`` reads it in preference to ``sizeHint().height()`` whenever it is available.

records.source: **Its height floor is in the QSS, not here.** ``setFixedSize`` does not survive polish, and neither does answering through ``sizeHint`` / ``minimumSizeHint``: the app stylesheet's blanket ``QPushButton { min-height: 22px }`` becomes a real ``setMinimumHeight(22)``, and ``qSmartMinSize`` lets an explicit minimum override the hints. On a page that does not fit, every tile then collapses to 22 px and paints its name over its icon. See :data:`spacr.qt.theme.TILE_H`. The hints below are still worth having — they are what the layout *prefers* — and ``heightForWidth`` is overridden with them because ``QWidgetItem::sizeHint`` reads it in preference to ``sizeHint().height()`` whenever it is available.
records.translation: **其最小高度在 QSS 中设置，而不在这里。** ``setFixedSize`` 经过样式处理后不会保留，通过 ``sizeHint`` / ``minimumSizeHint`` 返回也一样：应用样式表中笼统的 ``QPushButton { min-height: 22px }`` 会变成真正的 ``setMinimumHeight(22)``，而 ``qSmartMinSize`` 允许显式最小值覆盖这些提示。在放不下的页面上，每个磁贴随后都会塌缩到 22 px，并把名称画在图标上。参见 :data:`spacr.qt.theme.TILE_H`。下面的提示仍然值得保留——它们是布局*偏好*的尺寸——并且 ``heightForWidth`` 也用它们覆盖了，因为只要可用，``QWidgetItem::sizeHint`` 就会优先读取它，而不是 ``sizeHint().height()``。

records.context: The notes are bundled, and the bundle is what is drawn. records.context: Newer releases are then added. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it. After the page is shown, :attr:`refresh_requested` asks the window to read the public releases list on a background execution unit, and :meth:`apply_releases` merges whatever comes back in front of the bundled list. Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.

records.translation: 随后会添加更新的版本。某个版本的 wheel 不可能包含它自己的发布说明——发布说明是在 GitHub 发布时写的，而那时该 wheel 已经在 PyPI 上——因此打包的文件总是比携带它的构建落后一个版本。页面显示后，:attr:`refresh_requested` 会请求窗口在工作线程上读取公开的发布列表，:meth:`apply_releases` 再把返回的内容合并到打包列表之前。这里不会打开任何套接字：面板只是发出请求，而获取失败、受到速率限制、在 Preferences 中被关闭，或只是没有找到更新的版本时，打包列表都保持绘制时的原样。

records.context: This is not a Markdown renderer. records.translation: 这不是一个 Markdown 渲染器。版本正文是 GitHub 风格的 markdown；实际上其中包含的是项目符号列表、裸 URLs 和 ``**bold**``，而 QLabel 只能理解少数几种标签。因此：先转义一切内容——正文是来自网页的文本，绝不能以标记的形式进入富文本控件——然后再恢复值得保留的三种结构。

records.context: Pausing means holding the workflow at a point where nothing is half-written — between microscope fields of view, not mid-write. spaCR's workflows do not yet offer such a checkpoint, so a Pause button here could only freeze the thread wherever it happened to be, which can truncate a mask file or leave a microscope field of view measured into some tables and not others.

records.source: **On the Pause button.** It is enabled if and only if the running job's entry point declares itself ``bridge.pausable`` — i.e. it actually polls ``bridge.checkpoint()``. records.translation: 设置了 **Reset** 水位线时从该水位线开始计数，这是唯一一种无法通过缓存的总计文件回答的情况：该文件保存的是整个生命周期的计数，因此按时间窗口计数必须遍历窗口所覆盖的运行。其开销以窗口大小为上限，正是这一特性使该功能代价可控——昨天重置的人统计的是昨天以来的运行，而不是一万一千次运行。
